notes.title: Are you experiencing some Crashes?
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Are you experiencing crashes and other inconveniences when using liteCam Android?

Then send us;
[list]
[*]Your Android device name and Android version
[*] Your Computer system information
[*] liteCam Android log files
[/list]
 

How to create and export below 2 files; 

[b][u] System Information[/u][/b] 
[olist]
[*]Please note this is the default location if you do not change the steam library.
[list] 
[*] For 64 bit windows; 
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\liteCam Android\Info.exe 
[*] For 32 bit windows: 
C:\Program Files\Steam\SteamApps\common\liteCam Android\Info.exe 
[/list]
[*]You will be prompted with the 「System - Info」 dialog box. Click File > Save from the dialog box. This will save your system information as a TXT file and you can send this file. 
[/olist]

[b][u]*.log” files[/u][/b]
[olist] 
[*]Your default directory for liteCam Android log is:
[i]\My Documents\liteCam\Log's Directory[/i]
There will be “*.log” files saved in this directory. 
[*]Please zip the files and send it to us. 
[/olist]

Send them to litecam@rsupport.com 

Thank you. 

Best Regards, 
liteCam HD Team
